subject: math
question: 设函数 $u(x, y)$ 和 $v(x, y)$ 在闭区域 $D: x^2 + y^2 \leqslant 1$ 上有一阶连续偏导数，又 $f(x, y) = v(x, y)i + u(x, y)j$ ， $g(x, y) = \left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\right)i + \left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\right)j$ ，且在 $D$ 的边界上有 $u(x, y) \equiv 1$ ， $v(x, y) \equiv y$ ，求 $\iint_{D} f \cdot g \, \mathrm{d}\sigma$ .
answer: \begin{array}{r l} \iint_ {D} \boldsymbol {f} \cdot \boldsymbol {g} \mathrm{d} \sigma & = \iint_ {D} \left(\frac {\partial (u v)}{\partial x} - \frac {\partial (u v)}{\partial y}\right) \mathrm{d} \sigma = \oint_ {L} u v \mathrm{d} x + u v \mathrm{d} y \\ & = \oint_ {L} y \mathrm{d} x + y \mathrm{d} y = - \iint_ {D} \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y = - \pi . \end{array}

steps.text: 分析 由于只知道函数 $u(x, y)$ 和 $\nu(x, y)$ 在区域 $D$ 的边界上的表达式，所以需利用格林公式将二重积分化为曲线积分来计算.

因为 $f \cdot g = v \left( \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial u}{\partial y} \right) + u \left( \frac{\partial v}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial v}{\partial y} \right) = v \cdot \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} + u \cdot \frac{\partial v}{\partial x} - \left( v \cdot \frac{\partial u}{\partial y} + u \cdot \frac{\partial v}{\partial y} \right) = \frac{\partial(uv)}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial(uv)}{\partial y}$ .

solution.final_answer: \begin{array}{r l} \iint_ {D} \boldsymbol {f} \cdot \boldsymbol {g} \mathrm{d} \sigma & = \iint_ {D} \left(\frac {\partial (u v)}{\partial x} - \frac {\partial (u v)}{\partial y}\right) \mathrm{d} \sigma = \oint_ {L} u v \mathrm{d} x + u v \mathrm{d} y \\ & = \oint_ {L} y \mathrm{d} x + y \mathrm{d} y = - \iint_ {D} \mathrm{d} x \mathrm{d} y = - \pi . \end{array}
